Fixed abstract Unix socket path handling in:

- `tokio/src/net/unix/listener.rs`
- `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs`

Both now remove the user-facing leading NUL before passing the name to `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, which itself adds the required abstract-socket NUL byte.

Validated with:

```sh
cargo test -p tokio --all-features --test uds_stream abstract_socket_name
cargo test -p tokio --all-features --test uds_stream
```

All 8 Unix stream integration tests pass. `git diff --check` also passes.
